title: Kompetenzen-Shard (RIS Lehrplan 2023)
description: One shard per subject x band at plugin/data/kompetenzen/<band>/<fach>.json. Amends plan-austria-plan.md section 4.9 per FINDINGS.md V-22/V-24/V-53/V-54/V-57 and data-pipeline/notes/deviations.md. Enums are tolerant defaults per plan section 0.1 / E2-16: unknown values are kept and logged, never dropped by this schema. additionalProperties is left open (true) throughout on purpose -- see the E3-01 report -- so a tolerable surprise from the live RIS source never turns into a hard schema-validation failure. The only hard failures modelled here are a missing id/stufe/text on a competence or application-area record; ID-collision detection happens in the Python pipeline, not in this schema (JSON Schema has no practical way to assert uniqueness of a field across a heterogeneous nested structure).

band.description: Closed by design (frozen ID-grammar decision): Band = PRIM | SEK1. Not a tolerant position.

code.description: Fach = M | D | E | SU | ... (plan section 4.8). Tolerant: deliberately not a closed enum, more subjects arrive after E3-01.

uebergreifende_themen_legende.description: Footnote-number -> theme-name map built from the per-subject legend table (FINDINGS.md V-56). Keys are the raw <super> digit strings.

anwendungsbereiche_status.description: Amended per FINDINGS.md V-24: primary Mathematik has no Anwendungsbereiche section at all, hence 'keine'. Closed by design -- this value drives which downstream shape a consumer should expect, so an unrecognised status is a real error, not a tolerable surprise.

lehrstoff_quelle.description: aus_anwendungsbereichen | eigen_ausgewiesen (plan section 4.5). Lives at subject/meta level, matching parse_lehrplan.py's SubjectSpec.lehrstoff_quelle and result_to_dict() -- the plan's section 4.9 draft placed it per-competence, which the parser does not do.

anwendungsbereiche_bloecke.description: The application-block container for the two coarse-attachment binding axes: bindung: stufe (PRIM.D, PRIM.SU -- items attached to a whole school year, not to any one competence or area) and bindung: bereich (SEK1.D -- items attached to (bereich, stufe), not to one competence). Renamed from meta.anwendungsbereiche_je_stufe (data-pipeline/notes/deviations.md, 2026-07-30 row): the old name lied for SEK1.D, whose blocks are area-bound, not year-bound. Keyed by stufe (SCH1..SCH4 for PRIM; K1..K4 for SEK1.D). The two block shapes are structurally identical, so a single $defs entry (anwendungsbereiche_block_eintrag) covers both -- a second parallel $defs would duplicate a shape without adding information. But a recombined document must not depend on 'the area is implied by the file it came from': a bereich-bound entry therefore states its own area explicitly via bereich_name/bereich_slug, enforced by that $defs entry's if/then. By design the complete block is repeated verbatim in every area part file's meta (plan section 5 B1 contract: a skill loading one area file must see all items without reading a second file) and is deliberately never copied onto individual competence records -- that would assert a per-competence attribution the source does not make.

anwendungsbereiche_bindung.description: E12-02/V-58 audit: mirrors parse_lehrplan.py's SubjectSpec.anwendungsbereiche_bindung verbatim, so a consumer loading one part file can tell 'the regulation offers only prose / nothing here' (prosa/keine) from 'the build dropped the items', without guessing from which fields happen to be present. kompetenz = SEK1.M (per-competence join); bereich = SEK1.D (per-(bereich,stufe) block); stufe = PRIM.D, PRIM.SU (per-school-year block); prosa = SEK1.E (a heading followed by prose, zero items); keine = PRIM.M (no Anwendungsbereiche section at all). NOT YET REQUIRED: build_dataset.py does not emit this field yet (E12-11); it becomes required once it does, so the already-shipped SEK1.M shard does not go schema-invalid in the meantime. Valid but optional for now.

bildungsstandard_bezug.description: E12-02 audit: lets finde_bildungsstandard_bezug read a data fact instead of hardcoding the Sachunterricht exception -- Sachunterricht has no Bildungsstandard verordnet at all, every other of the six shards does. NOT YET REQUIRED: build_dataset.py does not emit this field yet (E12-11); it becomes required once it does. Valid but optional for now.

kompetenzbereiche.description: Stays exactly the official competence areas (4 for Sek I Mathematik) -- faithful to the regulation's structure per FINDINGS.md V-57. The 2 GZ-integrative competences do NOT add a 5th entry here.

zusatzkompetenzen.description: Top-level sibling array (FINDINGS.md V-57 / deviations.md row 2026-07-27 GZINTEGRATIV): competences that fit none of the official numbered Kompetenzbereiche, e.g. 'Integrative Fuehrung von Geometrisches Zeichnen'. Entries are Kompetenz objects carrying bereich_name and bereich_nummer: null. They have no Anwendungsbereiche counterpart in the source at all -- that is expected, not an error.

digitale_technologien_vorschlaege.description: Top-level sibling array for application-area items with art: digitale_technologien (FINDINGS.md V-54). These are the per-class-year 'Vorschlaege fuer den Einsatz digitaler Technologien' lists: they precisify no competence and carry kompetenz_id: null, so they cannot be nested inside any single Kompetenz.anwendungsbereiche[] the way praezisierung items are. Symmetric with zusatzkompetenzen[] for the same reason: content the source genuinely does not attach to a competence.

provenienz.description: Per-entry provenance block (plan section 4.9, jsonc block right after). Real values for the three pinned regulations live in data-pipeline/resources/manifest.json.

kurztitel.description: e.g. 'Lehrplan der Volksschule' / 'Lehrplaene der Mittelschulen' -- record the live RIS value verbatim (FINDINGS.md V-51).

kundmachung.description: Kundmachungsorgan, e.g. 'BGBl. II Nr. 185/2012 idF BGBl. II Nr. 178/2025'.

kompetenzbereich.description: Field names follow parse_lehrplan.py's Kompetenzbereich dataclass (nummer, name, slug), not the plan draft's 'id_teil' -- amended so the schema accepts real parser output.

nummer.description: The official Kompetenzbereich number (1-4 for Sek I Mathematik). Nullable (FINDINGS.md V-59/V-62): measured against the live documents, only SEK1.M numbers its Kompetenzbereiche ('Kompetenzbereich <n>: <Name>') -- every other subject's area heading is unnumbered ('Kompetenzbereich Lesen', 'Sozialwissenschaftlicher Kompetenzbereich'), so 'nummer' is null for every area in five of six shards. Stays required: the field must be present and explicitly null rather than omitted, so a consumer can tell 'this area has no official number' from 'the build forgot the field'. The stable area identity across all six shards is 'slug', never 'nummer'.

slug.description: ID segment, e.g. 'ZAHLEN'. Deterministic fallback via slugify_bereich() for unmapped area names.

zentrales_konzept.description: Plan section 4.6 field. Not yet emitted by parse_lehrplan.py (Kompetenzbereich carries no such field) -- kept optional here for a future enrichment pass, not required.

kompetenz.description: A single competence description. Used both nested under kompetenzbereiche[].kompetenzen[] and in the top-level zusatzkompetenzen[] array.

id.description: AT.LP23.<Band>.<Fach>.<Bereich>.<Stufe>.<lfd>. Structural shape only -- area codes are not enumerated here, that table belongs to data-pipeline/schema/id_schema.py (owned by a parallel task).

bereich_nummer.description: May be null (FINDINGS.md V-57): the GZ-integrative competences fit no numbered Kompetenzbereich.

text.description: Verbatim quotable sentence. May contain one or more ⟦ABB:<datei>⟧ tokens (FINDINGS.md V-53) -- such records are complete quotations, not flagged incomplete; see 'abbildungen' below. NOT a complete quotation on its own: the published sentence is 'stammsatz' + 'text' -- see 'stammsatz'.

text_roh.description: Same traversal as 'text' but with superscript footnote digits inlined instead of stripped (parse_lehrplan.py ExtractedText.roh). Nothing is lost.

uebergreifende_themen.description: Resolved theme names (footnote number -> name via meta.uebergreifende_themen_legende).

themen_marker_roh.description: Raw <super> contents before resolution against the theme legend, e.g. ['6, 7']. Not yet in the plan draft; emitted by the parser.

fussnoten_unaufgeloest.description: Super markers that did not resolve against the theme legend (ordinary footnotes, not cross-cutting themes). Not yet in the plan draft; emitted by the parser.

bildungsstandard_deskriptoren.description: Forward-looking (plan section 4.6); not yet emitted by parse_lehrplan.py -- populated by the future BiSt join step (E8).

anwendungsbereiche.description: Application-area items with art: praezisierung that join to this competence. digitale_technologien items never appear here -- see the top-level digitale_technologien_vorschlaege[] array.

lehrstoff.description: Only meaningfully populated when meta.lehrstoff_quelle is eigen_ausgewiesen (plan section 4.5); for aus_anwendungsbereichen subjects this stays empty/absent by design, the Anwendungsbereiche items already carry the content.

abbildungen.description: One entry per ⟦ABB:...⟧ token in 'text', in document order (FINDINGS.md V-53).

anwendungsitem.description: One Anwendungsbereich/Lehrstoff precisification item, or one digitale_technologien suggestion item (FINDINGS.md V-54). The two are discriminated by 'art'.

id.description: AT.LP23.<Band>.<Fach>.AB.<Bereich>.<Stufe>.<lfd> for a praezisierung item; .DT. instead of .AB. for a digitale_technologien item. The <Bereich> segment (and its trailing dot) is entirely absent for the area-free form (data-pipeline/schema/id_schema.py, E-P3): AT.LP23.<Band>.<Fach>.<Art>.<Stufe>.<lfd>, used only for bindung: stufe items (PRIM.D, PRIM.SU), which attach to a whole school year and no area at all -- inventing one would assert a scoping the regulation does not make. Structural shape only, per the frozen ID grammar owned by data-pipeline/schema/id_schema.py.

bereich_name.description: Absent/omitted for bindung: stufe items (E-P3) -- the regulation attaches these to the whole school year, not to any one area; see 'bindung'.

bindung.description: E-P3: what this item is scoped to, mirroring parse_lehrplan.py's SubjectSpec.anwendungsbereiche_bindung axis so a consumer can tell what an item attaches to without guessing from which fields happen to be present. 'kompetenz' (SEK1.M only) -- attaches to one competence, kompetenz_id is set. 'bereich' (SEK1.D) -- attaches to (bereich, stufe); kompetenz_id is null, bereich_name/bereich_nummer are set. 'stufe' (PRIM.D, PRIM.SU) -- attaches to (stufe) only, no area; kompetenz_id and bereich_name/bereich_nummer are all null/absent, and the id carries the area-free form. Not JSON-Schema-required on the item itself (same tolerant-by-default reasoning as 'verbindlich' below): a subject under anwendungsbereiche_status 'keine' has no items at all, 'prosa' (SEK1.E) has a heading but zero items so no item ever needs to carry bindung: prosa, and a digitale_technologien item (art) may also omit it -- it precisifies no competence regardless of its subject's bindung axis, so none of the three values describes it more accurately than omission.

uebergreifende_themen.description: Resolved cross-cutting-theme names for this application item (footnote number -> name via meta.uebergreifende_themen_legende). Optional: omission means this array is empty.

themen_marker_roh.description: Raw <super> contents from this application item before resolution against the subject theme legend, for example ['6, 7']. Optional: omission means this array is empty.

fussnoten_unaufgeloest.description: Application-item superscript markers that do not resolve against the subject theme legend (ordinary footnotes, not cross-cutting themes). Optional: omission means this array is empty.

verbindlich.description: Under anwendungsbereiche_status: item_flags, every real item carries this. Not JSON-Schema-required here: 'the only hard failures are a missing id/stufe/text' (E3-01 brief) -- a subject under optional_sektion or keine status may have no per-item binding flag at all.

art.description: praezisierung | digitale_technologien (FINDINGS.md V-54). Deliberately typed as a free string, not a closed enum -- tolerant per plan section 0.1/E2-16: an unknown 'art' value must still validate, not be rejected.

kompetenz_id.description: Nullable (E-P3): populated only for bindung: kompetenz items (SEK1.M, the V-27 verbatim text-repetition join). null for digitale_technologien items (FINDINGS.md V-54) and for every bindung: bereich / bindung: stufe item -- the regulation attaches those to an area or a school year, not to one competence, and synthesising a link the source does not make would misattribute the content. Present so any item that ends up outside a competence's nested anwendungsbereiche[] array (see digitale_technologien_vorschlaege[] and meta.anwendungsbereiche_je_stufe) still carries an explicit, honest 'no competence' marker instead of silently omitting the field.

abbildung.description: Inline formula-image metadata (FINDINGS.md V-53). One entry per ⟦ABB:<datei>⟧ token. Required is deliberately just the three fields a renderer consumes at render time (verified against plugin/skills/at-unterrichtsplanung/scripts/render_lesson_docx.py, render_lesson_html.py and lesson_common.py's split_abbildungen/resolve_abbildung_path/abbildung_missing_marker/abbildung_alt) -- token to match the ⟦ABB:...⟧ token in text, pfad to resolve the image file, datei as the fallback label if the file is missing. plugin/data/abbildungen/registry.json, keyed by datei, is the authoritative home for nor/quelle_url/breite_px/hoehe_px/sha256 (an image's provenance and dimensions); those five remain valid, optional properties here for a record that legitimately carries its own copy (e.g. older data, or schema/beispiel_kompetenzen.json's illustrative shape prior to this slimming), but a builder is not required to inline them once they are recorded in the registry.

fehlvorstellung.description: Curated from recognised subject-didactics literature, never LLM-generated (plan section 4.6). Forward-looking: not emitted by parse_lehrplan.py, populated by a separate human-reviewed step.

stufe.description: Amended per FINDINGS.md V-22: primary is per school year (SCH1..SCH4), not per Grundstufe. GS1/GS2/VOR are removed entirely, not kept as alternatives. Closed by design -- 'stufe' drives ID generation and progression joins, so a value outside this set is a real error (see the negative test for a rejected 'GS1').

kompetenz.stammsatz.description: The competence stem paragraph verbatim as published (FINDINGS.md V-58, data-pipeline/notes/deviations.md 2026-07-30 row). Normally the bare 'Die Schuelerinnen und Schueler koennen', but in Sek I (Erste) Lebende Fremdsprache it carries a load-bearing CEFR performance condition -- verbatim from the source: 'Die Schuelerinnen und Schueler koennen, wenn sehr langsam, klar und deutlich in Standardsprache gesprochen wird,' -- which qualifies every competence in the block that follows. A faithful quotation of the competence is 'stammsatz' + the item 'text'; neither field alone is the published sentence, and any consumer (renderer, skill, crosswalk) that quotes 'text' without 'stammsatz' produces an incomplete and potentially misleading quotation. This is a consumer obligation, not decoration. NOT YET REQUIRED on kompetenz: build_dataset.py does not emit this field yet (E12-11/E12-06); it becomes required once it does, so the already-shipped SEK1.M shard does not go schema-invalid in the meantime. Valid but optional for now.

anwendungsbereiche_block_eintrag.description: One meta.anwendungsbereiche_bloecke entry, keyed by stufe: one school-year's or one (area, school-year)'s worth of coarsely-attached application items, covering both bindung: stufe (PRIM.D, PRIM.SU -- items attached to a whole school year, no area) and bindung: bereich (SEK1.D -- items attached to (bereich, stufe), no single competence). Renamed from anwendungsbereiche_je_stufe_eintrag (data-pipeline/notes/deviations.md, 2026-07-30 row). The two shapes are structurally identical, so one $defs entry covers both rather than duplicating the shape across two parallel definitions -- but a recombined document must not depend on 'the area is implied by the file it came from', so a bereich-bound entry states its own area explicitly via bereich_name/bereich_slug (enforced below, not merely documented), while a stufe-bound entry must NOT carry them -- attaching a year-bound block to an area is exactly the misattribution this design exists to prevent.

bindung.description: 'stufe' (PRIM.D, PRIM.SU): the block attaches to a whole school year, no area. 'bereich' (SEK1.D): the block attaches to (bereich, stufe) -- see bereich_name/bereich_slug below, both required in that case.

bereich_name.description: Required (and typed string) when bindung == 'bereich'; must be absent or null when bindung == 'stufe' -- see the if/then/else below. No bare 'type' here on purpose, the two branches set it.

bereich_slug.description: Required (and typed string) when bindung == 'bereich'; must be absent or null when bindung == 'stufe' -- see the if/then/else below. No bare 'type' here on purpose, the two branches set it.

items.description: Verbatim anwendungsitem objects for this block. For bindung: stufe, items are area-free (kompetenz_id and bereich_name/bereich_nummer null/absent, id in the area-free 7-segment form). For bindung: bereich, items carry bereich_name/bereich_nummer matching this block's area and kompetenz_id null.
